headline: Trent Konoe‑Doherty scores off bench as Molde beat KFUM Oslo
standfirst: His strike pushed Molde two goals clear in the win.
body:
![](img/articles/trent-konoe-doherty-scores-off-bench-as-molde-beat-kfum-oslo/lead.jpg)

Trent Konoe‑Doherty came off the bench for Molde in their clash with KFUM Oslo and delivered a goal that extended the lead to two, ultimately ensuring the Norwegian side collected all three points. The strike proved decisive in sealing the victory for Molde.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Trent Konoe‑Doherty entered as a substitute for Molde against KFUM Oslo
He scored to increase Molde's lead to two goals
The goal helped Molde secure three points from the match

headline: John O’Shea to become Manchester United interim manager
standfirst: He is expected to take charge before the Christmas break.
body: John O’Shea will be appointed as the interim manager of Manchester United, with the club planning for him to assume the position before the Christmas period. The temporary role is set to bridge the gap until a permanent appointment is made later in the season.

_facts: John O’Shea will be appointed as interim manager of Manchester United.
He is expected to assume the role by Christmas.

headline: John Egan Named Man of the Match for Hull
standfirst: The 33‑year‑old Irish player earned the accolade on Saturday.
body:
![](img/articles/john-egan-named-man-of-the-match-for-hull/lead.jpg)

On Saturday, Irish player John Egan, who is 33, received the Man of the Match award for his performance with Hull. The same day marked the retirement of fellow Irish athlete Katie Taylor, who concluded her career by securing an undisputed championship title. Both milestones highlighted the ongoing impact of Irish talent across sports.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: John Egan, aged 33, was named Man of the Match for Hull.
The event took place on a Saturday.
Katie Taylor retired, becoming an undisputed champion.

headline: Liam Scales scores header as Celtic beat St Mirren 2-1
standfirst: Celtic turned a 1-0 deficit around after Scales' early second‑half goal.
body:
![](img/articles/liam-scales-scores-header-as-celtic-beat-st-mirren-2-1/lead.jpg)

Celtic secured a 2-1 away victory over St Mirren, overturning a 1-0 deficit thanks to a second‑half header from Liam Scales that levelled the score early in the period. The win came after the match, which was played the previous day, saw Celtic rally to claim all three points.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Celtic won 2-1 away at St Mirren.
Liam Scales headed the equaliser early in the second half after Celtic fell behind 1-0.
The match took place the day before the post was made.

headline: Aaron Drinan nets hat‑trick for Swell Town against Colchester
standfirst: He has scored five goals in his first five games this season.
body:
![](img/articles/aaron-drinan-nets-hat-trick-for-swell-town-against-colchester/lead.jpg)

Aaron Drinan produced a hat‑trick for Swell Town in today's match versus Colchester United, taking his season tally to five goals from five games. The striker, who claimed the League Two Player of the Year award after scoring 22 goals last season, kept his scoring run alive. This five‑match goal streak underscores a strong opening to the campaign.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Aaron Drinan scored a hat‑trick for Swell Town against Colchester United today.
The hat‑trick brought his tally to five goals in his first five games of the season.
He scored 22 goals last season.
He won the League Two Player of the Year award last season.
